subject: Embed sync waveplan and rerank QA checkpoints
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@brightmart.com>, Samir Khan <samir.k@brightmart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T08:30:00Z
Subject: Embed sync waveplan and rerank QA checkpoints

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is a first-pass mutual action plan and a proposed "wave" schedule to roll embeddings + rerank into BrightMart search. High-level goals: reduce rerank latency under 120ms P50, validate rerank precision lift on the smoke set, and avoid a full backfill during the first two waves.

Key asks from your side for this week:
- Confirm preferred vector DB and index configuration (you mentioned Pinecone + 16-byte floats?)
- Share a 1k-document sample we can use for rerank smoke testing (if you prefer, Samir can drop a CSV)
- Point of contact for procurement/whitelisting (for any Dedicated capacity if needed)

Proposed waves (short):
1) Wave A (seed 1k docs) — QA + rerank smoke (2 weeks)
2) Wave B (top 100k) — partial index replication, evaluate P95 latency and CPU impact (3 weeks)
3) Wave C (full backfill) — staggered cutover with canary traffic (4 weeks)

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-BM-embed.xlsx (MAP), brightmart-index-schema-v2.csv (example schema).

I'll sync with Ben and Jordan to scope the canary checklist and rerank eval metrics. If the MAP works we can lock Wave A start on Monday 2027-05-10.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Park <elena.park@brightmart.com>

Cc: Samir Khan <samir.k@brightmart.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T10:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Embed sync waveplan and rerank QA checkpoints

Thanks Mina — this looks good as a starting point. A few clarifications from our side:

- Vector DB: we currently run Pinecone in us-west1 for search features; plan is to keep it for embedding reads. For writes we can provision a separate namespace for the migration.
- Schema: we use a 128-d float32 embedding today but are open to quantized 16-bit if Redwood recommends it for cost.
- Sample: attaching a 1k sample CSV (will confirm separately on PIIs).

Two asks:
1) Can you confirm how Redwood handles prefix/KV caching during a partial index? Will we be able to keep existing search responses stable during Wave B?
2) Our security/compliance team will want a short note on retention and audit logs — who should I loop in?

We can do Wave A start on 2027-05-10 as proposed if we get the canary checklist and rerank metric list by EOD 2027-05-06.

Appreciate it,
Elena
Elena Park
Head of Search Product, BrightMart
elena.park@brightmart.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Elena Park <elena.park@brightmart.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Embed sync waveplan and rerank QA checkpoints

Elena / Mina — quick technical notes from the implementation desk: 

- Pinecone is fine — we recommend using 16-bit quantized embeddings for long-term cost savings; for Wave A keep float32 to avoid introducing model drift in early evals.
- Prefix/KV caching: Redwood will maintain a separate prefix cache per replica; during a partial index we route queries for missing keys to your existing search fallback and merge rerank signals only for seeded docs. That approach keeps results stable while we evaluate lift.
- Index schema: see attached brightmart-index-schema-v2.csv; please confirm the primary key and timestamp fields.

Operational ask: Monica, can you own the procurement/whitelist POC for any dedicated capacity? I can scope the canary-run-checklist and share a minimal infra playbook.

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@brightmart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-06T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Embed sync waveplan and rerank QA checkpoints

Elena — thanks for the quick reply and the 1k sample. Samir / team — noted on retention; I'll loop in our Security lead separately (cc'ed on the MAP document).

Updated Wave A plan (condensed):
- Start: 2027-05-10
- Scope: 1k seeded docs, run rerank smoke tests (NDCG@10, precision@5)
- Acceptance criteria: +5-8% NDCG improvement on smoke set and P50 latency < 120ms
- Rollback: immediate switch to existing ranker, no write to primary index during Wave A

Action items before Monday 2027-05-10:
- BrightMart: confirm schema primary key and drop final sample (Samir) [IN-PROGRESS]
- Redwood: provide canary-run-checklist + minimal infra playbook (Ben) [ETA 2027-05-07]
- CS: lock MAP and owners (Mina/Monica) [ETA 2027-05-06 EOD]

I updated the MAP in the Drive link (see related_links) and attached the canary checklist temporary draft. Reply here with any blockers.

Best,
Mina

From: Samir Khan <samir.k@brightmart.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Elena Park <elena.park@brightmart.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Embed sync waveplan and rerank QA checkpoints

Mina / Elena — couple of practical concerns from engineering: 

- Traffic: Wave B magnitude could spike our qps by ~20% for hybrid searches. We need a concrete rollback and a cost estimate for Pinecone writes if we go beyond 100k docs.
- Rerank eval: attaching rerank-smoke-samples.zip with labelled judgments for ~300 queries (please keep this internal). Our primary metric is NDCG@10 but we'd also like to track failure modes (top-1 drift).

If possible, can Redwood simulate a canary with 5% traffic before full Wave B to validate latency and cost? That would make engineering comfortable.

Samir
Samir Khan
Staff Engineer, BrightMart
samir.k@brightmart.com

Subject: Re: Embed sync waveplan and rerank QA checkpoints — Canary run checklist and owners

Team — following up with a concise canary checklist and proposed owners for Wave A run (attached: canary-run-checklist.pdf):

- Owner: Jordan Blake (run coordination)
- Infra lead: Ben Carter (routing / cache config)
- CS lead: Mina Haddad (customer comms & rollback)
- Metrics: Monica Patel (NDCG/latency dashboards + alert thresholds)
- BrightMart POC: Samir Khan (sample validation)

Checklist highlights:
1) Pre-run smoke: run rerank-smoke-samples locally and verify NDCG trend (baseline vs seeded).
2) Canary traffic: 5% traffic mirroring for 48 hours (no writes to primary index).
3) Monitoring: set P50/P95 latency alerts and NDCG drift > 3% as immediate stop condition.
4) Rollback path: route queries to existing ranker; invalidate prefix cache; confirm 0 writes.

Next steps:
- Ben: share infra playbook + exact run command (ETA 2027-05-16).
- Monica: create a dashboard for NDCG/Top-1 drift (ETA 2027-05-17).
- Mina: confirm Wave A start with BrightMart (you had 2027-05-10; pushing to 2027-05-17 to accommodate security review).

Thanks — I've scheduled a 30-min sync for 2027-05-18 to run through the checklist.

Jordan
